title: Rust: Semantic Versioning
description: Implement a semantic version (SemVer) parser and comparator.

steps.title: Parse Version String
steps.description: Create a `Version` struct with `major: u32, minor: u32, patch: u32`. Write `Version::from_str("1.2.3")` that parses a version string. Print the parsed fields.
hints: `struct Version { major: u32, minor: u32, patch: u32 }`
Split by '.' and parse each part.

verification.failureMessage: Parse '1.2.3' and print major=1, minor=2, patch=3.

steps.title: Version Comparison
steps.description: Implement `PartialOrd` and `Ord` for Version. Compare 2.0.0 > 1.9.9, 1.0.0 == 1.0.0, 1.0.0 < 2.0.0. Print comparison results.
hints: Compare major first, then minor, then patch.
`fn cmp(&self, other: &Self) -> Ordering { (self.major, self.minor, self.patch).cmp(&(other.major, other.minor, other.patch)) }`

steps.title: Pre-release and Build Metadata
steps.description: Extend Version with `pre: Option<String>` (e.g., `-alpha.1`) and `build: Option<String>` (e.g., `+build.123`). Parse `"1.0.0-alpha.1+build.456"` and print all fields.
hints: Split on `-` for pre-release, then on `+` for build metadata.
Pre-release has lower precedence than patch but higher than no pre-release.

verification.failureMessage: Parse a version with pre-release and build metadata.

steps.title: Version Range Parsing
steps.description: Parse version ranges like `">=1.0.0 <2.0.0"` or `"^1.2.3"` (compatible) or `"~1.2.0"` (approximately equivalent). Implement `matches(&self, range: &str) -> bool`.

steps.title: Sorting Versions
steps.description: Create a list of versions: `["2.0.0", "1.0.0-alpha", "1.0.0", "2.0.0-rc.1", "1.5.0"]`. Sort them according to SemVer precedence rules. Print the sorted list.
hints: Pre-release versions have lower precedence than the release.

verification.failureMessage: Sort and print the list of versions.
